# Bluepin

> Diabetes Management with personalised AI insights

Bluepin is a comprehensive diabetes management app that tracks your glucose levels, analyzes your health reports, and provides personalized AI-driven insights to help you manage your health as a whole.

## Key Features

- **Personalized AI Insights**: Receive actionable advice tailored to your health data.
- **Glucose Tracking**: Monitor and log your glucose levels effectively.
- **Health Report Analysis**: Let our AI parse and summarize your medical reports.
- **Holistic Health Management**: Care for multiple organs and understand how diabetes affects your overall well-being.
